summary: OurRealm Responsibility Center (Phase 1) — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. 27/27 pytest tests pass covering role management, remove/leave, PATCH edit, non-member 403s, invite/respond error paths, dashboard permission gating (member excludes vault_transactions, owner includes), fund_vault permission + validation, /mine + /config shape. Frontend E2E covered: hub page (balance, cards, invites), creation wizard (3 steps, disabled Review when name empty, cost panel shows correct balance), dashboard (3 stat cards, 4 tabs, owner sees owner-note & NO Leave button, settings edit save, vault fund 5FP moved balance 200→205), Members tab invite panel, AccountSettings /settings/account 'Centers' tab lists 1 row, Settings page 'Open Responsibility Center' link navigates. Regression /feed loads.
critical_code_review_comments: services/responsibility_center.py uses safe conditional atomic $inc for balances (fire_wallets + center vault_balance) — race-safe against concurrent burns. Good pattern.

Idempotency implemented via unique index on responsibility_center_transactions.idempotency_key + reservation row (status='reserved') → completed. Duplicate create returns {duplicate:true} without double-charge — verified by main agent curls.

role rank check in set_role is correct: actor_rank < 4 (non-owner) requires target_rank AND requested_role_rank < actor_rank; owner (rank 4) bypasses. Owner role can never be assigned/changed (400 for assign, blocked for change).
Notification insert on invite is wrapped in try/except so notification failures don't block invites — good defensive coding.
MongoDB _id is correctly projected out ({"_id":0}) everywhere. No serialization risk observed.
Minor observation: /api/auth/me returned a shape where uid was accessed as .id or .user.id — the test handled both. Not an RC issue.
Minor: routers/responsibility_center.py has no explicit response_model classes (uses raw dicts). Acceptable for Phase 1 but could tighten later.
